name: worldwatcher
buildCommand: node damincidents/scripts/build-version.js && rm -rf .vercel-out && mkdir .vercel-out && cp -R damincidents/. .vercel-out/ && rm -rf .vercel-out/__pycache__ .vercel-out/*.pyc && rm -f .vercel-out/server.py .vercel-out/maintain.py .vercel-out/js/maintain.js .vercel-out/README.md

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.vercel-insights.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://*.basemaps.cartocdn.com https://server.arcgisonline.com https://cdn.vercel-insights.com; connect-src 'self' https://cdn.vercel-insights.com https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://github.com; upgrade-insecure-requests; object-src 'none'
